Watt, have sacked coach Manolo González following Tuesday's Copa del Rey exit to fourth-tier side Sestao River.</description><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 22:59:30 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1027/r1737240_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Yamal excited despite Ballon d'Or miss: 'Good things take time'</title><link>https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50301141/yamal-excited-ballon-dor-miss</link><description>Barcelona star Lamine Yamal won best young talent for a third-straight year at Monday's Ballon d'Or, but the 19-year-old has his sights set on the big prize.</description><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 21:46:47 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1017/r1732115_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Why Real Madrid's Mbappé, Barcelona's Yamal lost Ballon d'Or</title><link>https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/50295834/why-real-madrid-kylian-mbappe-barcelona-lamine-yamal-lost-ballon-dor-harry-kane</link><description>Kylian Mbappé and Lamine Yamal both achieved greatness last season, but it still wasn't enough for either of them to claim soccer's top individual prize.</description><pubDate>Tue, 27 Oct 2026 14:04:11 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1027/r1736954_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
